entities.summary: The Unified Communist Party of Georgia is a political party in Georgia. It was founded in June 1994 through the merger of the Stalin Society, the Georgian Workers Communist Party and the Union of Communists of Georgia. The party is member of Union of Communist Parties — Communist Party of the Soviet Union. United Communist Party of Georgia is a political party in Tbilisi, established in 1994.
